textSlots.defaultValue: Past and present melt into one: the experience of Horacio, the energy and passion of his team, and the knowledge that turns every Pagani project into an impossible dream that feels close to reality.

textSlots.defaultValue: It is the quest for perfection that drives man to go beyond his limits and exceed, the science to rewrite its rules and the car to evolve constantly, in what can be defined as an ongoing challenge between intellect and creativity.
